description: This file contains utility functions for gradient clipping in PyTorch, including implementation details for clipping gradient norms and values, supporting both in-place modifications and support for different device types with optional 'foreach' APIs.

methods.name: Callable[_P,_R] _no_grad(func: Callable[_P, _R])
methods.description: A decorator that wraps a function to execute within a torch.no_grad() context, preventing gradient computations during its execution.

methods.name: torch.Tensor _get_total_norm( tensors: _tensor_or_tensors, norm_type: float = 2.0, error_if_nonfinite: bool = False, foreach: bool | None = None, )
methods.description: Computes the total norm of a collection of tensors or a single tensor, with support for different norm types and error handling for non-finite values.

methods.name: None _clip_grads_with_norm_( parameters: _tensor_or_tensors, max_norm: float, total_norm: torch.Tensor, foreach: bool | None = None, )
methods.description: Scales the gradients of parameters in-place to ensure their total norm does not exceed a specified maximum, using precomputed total norm.

methods.name: torch.Tensor clip_grad_norm_( parameters: _tensor_or_tensors, max_norm: float, norm_type: float = 2.0, error_if_nonfinite: bool = False, foreach: bool | None = None, )
methods.description: Clips gradients of parameters in-place based on their total norm and a maximum norm threshold.

methods.name: torch.Tensor clip_grad_norm( parameters: _tensor_or_tensors, max_norm: float, norm_type: float = 2.0, error_if_nonfinite: bool = False, foreach: bool | None = None, )
methods.description: Deprecated wrapper for clip_grad_norm_; calls the latter with a deprecation warning.

methods.name: None clip_grad_value_( parameters: _tensor_or_tensors, clip_value: float, foreach: bool | None = None, )
methods.description: Clamps the gradients of parameters in-place to a specified maximum absolute value.
